selection_policy: The complete upstream player table is retained without a recognition cap.
career_scope: career_goals/career_appearances: whole-career league totals from Wikidata (Wikipedia infobox figures) when complete for every senior club spell; otherwise official appearances in dcaribou/transfermarkt-datasets (2012+). See career_stats_source per player.
physical_data_policy: weight_kg is intentionally null until a separate physical dataset is supplied; no value is estimated.
source_policy: Transfermarkt (dcaribou/transfermarkt-datasets) for profiles, market values, current club and caps; Wikidata (CC0), joined by Transfermarkt player ID (P2446), for club history, career league totals, and players missing from the dataset (legends).
